readme: plugins/wasm/golden/README.md explains this file. Every module here is run by crates/plugin-host/tests/conformance.rs through the sandbox and, when it loads, through a real worker process; a module whose verdict drifts from this table fails the battery.

modules.name: noop
modules.claim: The smallest conformant guest loads and answers an empty payload.

modules.name: echo
modules.claim: A 32 KiB payload crosses the boundary in and back out unchanged.

modules.name: log-fill
modules.claim: 100 log lines is the documented budget and every one is captured.

modules.name: log-overflow
modules.claim: The 101st log line is dropped, has no in-band channel, and does not fail the invocation.

modules.name: log-over-line
modules.claim: A 4097-byte line is over the 4 KiB cap and is dropped whole, not truncated.

modules.name: now
modules.claim: The clock reads forward inside one invocation and the guest has no other time source.

modules.name: spin
modules.claim: A tight loop is stopped by the invocation's allowance; fuel or the clock binds first depending on instruction throughput, and the row names which.

modules.name: memory-bomb
modules.claim: Growth past the 64 MiB instance cap traps instead of returning -1 the guest could ignore.

modules.name: stack-overflow
modules.claim: Unbounded recursion is a trap, not a host crash.

modules.name: trap
modules.claim: An explicit trap is a guest trap and reaches no budget.

modules.name: output-bomb
modules.claim: A claimed length of u32::MAX is refused before a byte is copied.

modules.name: output-over-cap
modules.claim: One byte over the 1 MiB output cap is refused for the length alone.

modules.name: null-output
modules.claim: The zero word means no output, and the invocation is not a refusal.

modules.name: bad-alloc
modules.claim: A negative allocator answer is a frame refusal, never a write at a wrapped address.

modules.name: undeclared-import
modules.claim: An entry the ABI does not declare is refused at load, not per call.

modules.name: wasi-import
modules.claim: WASI is not importable by name.

modules.name: missing-export
modules.claim: A module missing one of the three exports does not load.

modules.name: bad-export-type
modules.claim: An entry with the wrong result type does not load, and the refusal names the type.

modules.name: kv-namespace
modules.claim: A path-shaped KV namespace label is refused with plugin_kv_namespace_denied, in band.

modules.name: http-ungranted
modules.claim: Egress with no network capability is refused before the profile is read.

modules.name: http-unconsented
modules.claim: Egress with the capability but no consented profile is refused, not attempted.

modules.name: event-undeclared
modules.claim: An event type the manifest does not declare is refused even with the capability.

modules.name: event-deferred
modules.claim: A fully gated emit is a typed not-implemented today, not a fake success.

modules.name: query-unknown
modules.claim: An id outside the closed query table is refused before the capability question.

modules.name: query-ungranted
modules.claim: A known query with no read capability is refused.

modules.name: query-deferred
modules.claim: A fully gated model read is a typed not-implemented today, not fabricated rows.
